_comment: Deliberate exceptions for scripts/check-docs-accuracy.mjs. Every entry needs a reason — an unexplained entry is how a checker stops catching things.

_reasons.schematic names: registerX/subscribeX/getX* and the Gadget* family are invented stand-ins in walkthroughs (registration-seams.md, state-and-stores.md, support-type-extension.md), not real symbols.
_reasons.external symbols: n_coords is a field of the third-party LYS format; version_comparator is a tauri-plugin-updater API.
_reasons.deliberately removed: kerf_mm is named in organic-cut-surface-redesign.md precisely to record that it is gone.
_reasons.aspirational: page-tsx-refactor-handoff.md is a refactor plan; its symbols name extractions not yet made. packageManager is a package.json key npm has not adopted here. contributesCrossSectionGeometry is a flag per-type-alias-cleanup.md PROPOSES adding if a derived cache key proves too broad.
_reasons.generated at build time: the paths are produced by scripts/generate-plugin-registry.mjs and scripts/generate-support-registrations.mjs, and are gitignored (**/generated*), so they are absent from a clean checkout.
_reasons.proposed, not built: island_replay is the name ADR-0025 proposes for a capability not yet folded in; pushToast is named in notifications.md precisely to state that no such API exists.
_reasons.upstream windowing APIs: PlatformWebview and cef_window_handle_t are tauri and CEF APIs; wl_surface and wl_subsurface are Wayland protocol objects; windowless_rendering_enabled and set_as_windowless belong to the cef crate. ADR-0005 and ADR-0040 cite them to explain why the Linux CEF build embeds through an X11 window id, so they name code we depend on but do not own.

_comment_webkit_symbols: The eight WebKit/JavaScriptCore internals above (javascript_gc_object_count through operationMapHash) are cited by docs/dev/performance-debugging.md as they appear in `sample` output and WebKit's own logs. They belong to the platform, not to this codebase, and will never be found here.
_comment_anchor_constants: ANCHOR_MIN_* / ANCHOR_SHAFT_MULTIPLIER: removed constants, cited by name in support-registry-findings.md because the finding IS their removal. The values live on the anchor descriptor's autoPlacement and are pinned by __tests__/autoPlacementPolicy.test.ts.
_comment_removed_support_symbols: updateTrunk / kickstandBefore / kickstandAfter: removed during the registry refactor and cited by name in support-registry-findings.md because the finding IS their removal. updateTrunk became the shared update skeleton; the kickstand* fields left AutoSupportPlan when kickstands joined SupportState. countAttachmentsOnTrunk / isTrunkAtAttachmentCapacity / gridTrunkIds / trunkOriginById: renamed when the auto-placement host logic was derived from `canBeGridHost`; support-registry-findings.md names them because the finding IS their replacement by countAttachmentsOnHost, isHostAtAttachmentCapacity, gridHostIds and hostOriginById. renderStickList / resolve<Type>ModelId: removed during the registry refactor and cited by name in support-registry-findings.md because the finding IS their removal -- renderStickList as the example of an identifier the grep metric counts, the four resolve*ModelId helpers as unreferenced code the finding said should be adopted or removed (they were removed). groupBuilders / GroupBuilder / buildTrunkGroup / buildBranchGroup: the export geometry table and its per-type builders, removed when that work moved into each type's own folder behind supports/exportGeometry/seam.ts; support-registry-findings.md names them because the finding IS their replacement. SUPPORT_KINDS / supportKindState / KIND_META / hasPlateRoot / hasContactCone / hasShaft / drawsOwnPreview / SupportKind / kindHas / kindDrawsOwnPreview / DEFAULT_SUPPORT_KIND / ANATOMY_PREVIEW_KINDS: the support sidebar's second registry, replaced by Settings/sidebarPanels.ts. Cited by name in support-registry-findings.md because the finding IS their removal -- the three settings flags are now derived from the registry, drawsOwnPreview became a self-registering preview, and the rest are the old vocabulary. PANEL_ICONS: the dead per-panel icon table (assigned, never rendered) removed with the sidebar panel derivation; support-registry-findings.md names it as one of the per-panel tables that name a support type.
_comment_removed_renderer_aliases: selectedTrunkIds / selectedStickIds: removed per-type aliases in SupportRenderer, cited by name in support-type-literal-plan.md §3G because removing them RAISED the rename-test count (71 -> 74). The anecdote only works if the old names are named.
_comment_removed_kickstand_transform_pas: transformAllKickstandsInState: removed while executing stump-stick-residual-plan.md section 5. It was the separate whole-scene pass that transformed kickstand segments AFTER the per-type switch, which did not list kickstands; the switch is gone and the derived walk covers them like every other type. SUPPORT_ENTITY_COLLECTIONS is named alongside it because it is the walk's key list, re-exported from supportCollections.ts rather than declared in the registry, so the symbol check cannot resolve it from the registry module.
_comment_removed_bespoke_updaters: updateLeaf / updateBrace: removed while executing support-hotspots-plan.md section 5. Each was a bespoke store updater whose body moved into its type folder as a settle hook (Leaf/leafSettle.ts, Brace/braceSettle.ts) reached through supports/settle/seam.ts, so the generic write path now serves every type. Cited by name because the finding IS their removal -- the same class as updateStump and updateTrunk.
_comment_removed_dead_renderer_local: stickList: removed while executing support-hotspots-plan.md section 4. One of eight per-type list locals in SupportRenderer, assigned and never used -- the residue of a render pass that had already moved. The plan cites it by name because the finding IS its removal.
_comment_removed_knot_index_builders: buildBranchesByParentKnotId / buildLeafIdsByParentKnotId / buildBraceIdsByKnotId: removed while executing support-hotspots-plan.md section 1. Three near-identical per-type index builders, replaced by one derived buildEntitiesByHostKnot that reads each entity's own type and that type's declared host-knot edges. The plan cites all three by name because the finding IS their removal -- the same class as updateTrunk and updateStump.
_comment_removed_collection_list: kickstandCountByModel: removed while executing stump-stick-residual-plan.md section 6. It was a hand-built per-model count of the kickstands collection, duplicating what getSupportsForModel already returns under that key; the callers now read that. stump-stick-residual-plan.md names it because the finding IS its removal -- the same class as updateTrunk and selectedStickIds.
_comment_removed_stump_updater: updateStump: removed while executing stump-stick-residual-plan.md §1. Its whole body was `replaceSupportEntity(stump)`, which is what the generic updater already does for every type registering nothing, so stump now takes the generic path and the symbol is gone. stump-stick-residual-plan.md and anchor-token-census.md cite it by name because the finding IS its removal -- the same class as updateTrunk above.
